title: Java: from the first compile to reliable applications
summary: 36 sequenced lessons with explanations, worked examples, six inspectable exercises and separate reference solutions. Content becomes runnable only when its complete authored set is registered.

lessons.title: From source file to running JVM
lessons.outcome: A Java program begins as text.

lessons.verification: one line Hello, Java. compiler resultfalse and at least one ERROR diagnostic.

lessons.title: Virtual threads and blocking work
lessons.outcome: Virtual threads are lightweight Java threads intended to make large numbers of blocking tasks easier to express.

lessons.title: JVM memory, GC and allocation
lessons.outcome: The JVM manages heap memory through reachability,not by immediately freeing an object when a local variable changes.
